def solve(N, Q, A, B):
    max_servings = float('inf')
    for i in range(N):
        max_A = Q[i] // A[i] if A[i] > 0 else float('inf')
        max_B = Q[i] // B[i] if B[i] > 0 else float('inf')
        max_servings = min(max_servings, max_A + max_B)
    return max_servings
